purpose: Coordinate the already-frozen TNC, event-stress and optical mechanism studies in one field campaign without changing any primary estimator, threshold, endpoint, geography-specific inference gate or claim boundary.

inferential_independence.rule: Sharing dates, cores or field visits does not combine the primary analyses. Each mechanism retains its own frozen eligibility, precision, variation, uncertainty and no-rescue rules.
inferential_independence.prohibited: Do not build a composite buffer score, multivariable winner model, mediation model, or cross-mechanism interaction after outcome inspection.

shared_calendar.pre_tnc: Core-three event/optical nodes use the frozen pre-exposure TNC round within 3 days of logger deployment.
shared_calendar.post_tnc: Core-three event/optical nodes use the frozen post-exposure TNC round within 3 days of logger retrieval, 39-45 days after pre-TNC.
shared_calendar.authoritative_tnc_baseline_reuse: For core-three nodes, a valid post-exposure TNC measurement is the preferred authoritative four-bay v2 baseline TNC measurement. Do not collect a third redundant TNC round.
shared_calendar.boca_ciega_baseline: Boca Ciega is not part of the frozen event/optical primary. Collect its authoritative v2 baseline TNC once during the same late-summer baseline campaign, under the same tissue/HPLC/core rules.
shared_calendar.baseline_transect_alignment: Pair the four-bay fixed-transect quantitative baseline to the authoritative baseline TNC within +/-14 days, preferably on the same node visit. Complete authoritative four-bay baseline TNC collection within one <=28-day campaign.
shared_calendar.future_outcome: The next prespecified fixed-transect survey supplies the v2 future quantitative response.

shared_tnc_sampling.no_sham_coring: Do not add a biologically unnecessary pre-coring round in Boca Ciega solely to mimic event-study disturbance.
shared_tnc_sampling.intervention_metadata: Record whether each authoritative baseline TNC node had a prior pre-exposure coring round, exact prior core offsets, dates and visible disturbance.
shared_tnc_sampling.asymmetry_boundary: Prior event-study coring is geographically structured and cannot be separated from water-body mean differences by adding a post-hoc indicator. Keep the frozen water-body factor, standardized destructive-sampling geometry and point-level disturbance sensitivity; do not reinterpret cross-bay mean TNC differences as a coring effect or ecological effect.
shared_tnc_sampling.invalidation_rule: If pre-coring visibly compromises a planned authoritative post-TNC anchor or permanent monitoring neighborhood, that anchor/node follows the predeclared destructive-sampling QC/sensitivity rule rather than being silently retained.

round_assignment.pre_post_two_round_nodes: Union of final core-three event-stress nodes and final core-three optical-primary nodes.
round_assignment.baseline_only_nodes: Authoritative four-bay TNC nodes not in the event/optical union, including Boca Ciega unless separately covered by an allowed module.
round_assignment.planned_full_frame_example: If event and optical both use the same 33 core-three nodes and TNC v2 uses all 41 planned nodes, minimum outcome-bearing core count before replacements is 33 x 6 + 8 x 3 = 222.
round_assignment.formula: minimum_core_samples = 6 * n(unique event OR optical nodes) + 3 * n(TNC-v2 baseline nodes outside that union)
round_assignment.subset_rule: Every event/optical node using TNC as a reserve response must also be present in the authoritative TNC-v2 baseline node registry unless a predeclared mechanism-specific exclusion makes the v2 baseline measurement invalid.

event_stress.simultaneous_requirement: A complete temperature+salinity node system must operate on the same frozen common calendar window. Sequential rotation across non-overlapping windows cannot create confirmatory n.
event_stress.other_gates: Retain all frozen common-overlap, coverage, within-bay exposure-identifiability and 30 C / 25 ppt no-retuning rules.

optical.simultaneous_requirement: A valid within-canopy PAR node system must operate on the frozen common calendar window. Sequential rotation across non-overlapping windows cannot create confirmatory n.

paired_reference_subset.role: secondary attribution diagnostic; not a prerequisite for optical-primary confirmatory status
paired_reference_subset.failure_action: If below 12 total or below 3 per bay, mark canopy-optical attribution non-confirmatory while retaining the optical primary if its own 30/8, DLI, timing and variation gates pass.

optical.other_gates: Retain frozen daily-DLI daylight-gap QC, sensor-height pilot and no-season-shift rules.

hydrodynamic.role: Separate module, not a resource prerequisite for the integrated TNC/event/optical campaign.
hydrodynamic.rule: Run in parallel only if independent equipment/crew capacity cannot reduce TNC, event-stress or optical compliance. Otherwise schedule it separately under its own frozen 21-day and bare-control rules.

resource_gate.principle: Before the first outcome-bearing pre-TNC core or logger deployment, freeze instrument inventory, node allocation, calibration/pilot status and route feasibility without using any future TNC or meadow response.
resource_gate.insufficient_capacity_rule: If capacity cannot meet a mechanism's frozen confirmatory sampling frame, predeclare that mechanism as pilot/non-confirmatory for that campaign. Do not rotate instruments into different weather windows or drop inconvenient bays after exposure is observed.
resource_gate.no_cross_mechanism_rescue: Failure or non-estimability of one mechanism cannot be rescued by adding another mechanism's exposure to its primary model.
resource_gate.optical_capacity_note: Count simultaneous sampling volumes/node systems, not necessarily physical logger boxes: multi-channel hardware may satisfy multiple synchronized sampling volumes only if the frozen calibration and synchronization rules are met.
resource_gate.analysis_freeze_rule: Before the first outcome-bearing core/logger, freeze the authoritative TNC-v2 primary analysis code and node-level uncertainty procedure. If event or optical is marked confirmatory, freeze that module's primary analysis code as well. Disabled modules do not require outcome-bearing analysis code.
resource_gate.tnc_precollection_dependency: Integrated readiness must import and pass the separate field/tnc_v2_precollection_freeze.json fail-closed system; duplicating only node counts is not sufficient.
resource_gate.calendar_semantics: Freeze explicit node-level logger deployment/retrieval, pre/post TNC visit, authoritative TNC-baseline and fixed-transect-baseline calendars. Readiness must verify the July 24-September 3 exposure structure, >=35-day common overlap, 39-45 day pre/post TNC pairing, <=28-day authoritative four-bay TNC campaign, and +/-14-day baseline alignment.

claim_boundary: This is an execution/orchestration contract, not a new ecological hypothesis or estimator.
The four-bay TNC primary and the three-bay event/optical/hydrodynamic designs retain different geographies by design.
Co-deployment improves temporal comparability and reduces destructive sampling; it does not turn observational associations into causal experiments.
No binary re-recording endpoint is treated as ecological recovery.

The integrated campaign has one protected decisive biological primary line (four-bay TNC v2) plus optional confirmatory forcing modules. Hardware scarcity must disable an optional forcing module before outcome-bearing sampling rather than degrade TNC v2.
Paired above-canopy PAR is secondary attribution only; inadequate reference-sensor capacity does not by itself invalidate the optical within-canopy DLI primary.

When event and optical primaries are both confirmatory and estimable, any joint paper-level 'environmental forcing' claim uses the frozen two-test family correction; standalone contract statuses remain separately reported.

priority_order: core-three optical primary if full confirmatory capacity exists
core-three event-stress primary if full confirmatory capacity exists
module_priority_and_failure_policy.tnc_v2_rule: The outcome-bearing campaign may proceed only if the authoritative TNC-v2 precollection freeze and >=36 total / >=6 per bay planned baseline frame are ready. TNC v2 is not downgraded to preserve another module.
module_priority_and_failure_policy.optional_module_rule: Before any outcome-bearing pre-TNC core, freeze event_module_intent and optical_module_intent as confirmatory or disabled. If a module lacks its full simultaneous confirmatory capacity, set it disabled for the outcome-bearing campaign rather than running an underpowered biological pilot that adds destructive pre-coring.
module_priority_and_failure_policy.disabled_module_boundary: A disabled event/optical module may still run response-independent sensor/geometry pilots, but it receives no mechanism-specific outcome-bearing pre/post TNC round beyond what the authoritative TNC baseline independently requires.
module_priority_and_failure_policy.optical_attribution_rule: Paired above-canopy PAR is a secondary physical-attribution diagnostic. Failure to reach 12 total / 3 per bay downgrades only the attribution subset, not the optical primary, provided the optical primary itself meets its frozen 30/8 and DLI gates.
module_priority_and_failure_policy.no_priority_reversal: Do not sacrifice four-bay TNC node count, seasonal synchronization, core geometry, preservation, or assay quality to keep an optional forcing module confirmatory.
module_priority_and_failure_policy.priority_consistency_note: If only one forcing primary can be fully confirmatory without weakening TNC-v2, optical has the frozen scientific priority over event-stress; feasibility still governs whether optical can actually proceed.

members: event-stress primary: joint_hot_fresh_hours_30_25 -> post-TNC conditional on pre-TNC
optical primary: mean_daily_within_canopy_dli -> post-TNC conditional on pre-TNC
paper_level_forcing_family.individual_contracts_unchanged: Each mechanism retains its own frozen 95% two-sided interval and supported/unsupported/non-estimable status.
paper_level_forcing_family.integrated_family_rule: If both event and optical primaries are confirmatory and estimable in the same campaign and the paper makes a joint claim that measured environmental forcing predicts reserve change, report a two-test family correction. Use Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided 97.5% intervals from the same frozen node-level resampling procedure for the family-level claim.
paper_level_forcing_family.interpretation: A 95% contract-level result may remain supported for its standalone mechanism while failing the integrated family-level threshold. Report both transparently.
paper_level_forcing_family.no_ranking: Do not compare p-values, interval widths, or standardized coefficients to declare one forcing mechanism 'stronger' without a separately frozen comparative model.
paper_level_forcing_family.correlation_boundary: Report the pre-response node-level correlation between event and optical exposures. If both support, do not call their effects statistically independent because they share nodes, weather interval and TNC response.
